title: 22-Year-Old Shoplifter Makes a Huge Mistake Over $20 Nails
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On April 27th, 2023. Officers were called to a store in regards to a woman who was trying to conceal items under her jacket. When the officer approached her to ask her what was going on, she said she had no idea what the officer was talking about, she then tried to run away from the officer even though he was going to give her a chance to pay for it. When she was apprehended, the item she tried to conceal came out of her shirt. The total of the item she tried to steal was valued at $20. The lady also gave officers a fake name and said she lived in a different state, which ws proven all to be false. This is footage of the events that followed.
